summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `import enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with the eleven members, values, and comments from the spec. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept endpoint_config=None (treated as no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults with the specified parameters, returning a mapping keyed by the eleven members. SDK::Endpoint is None when absent. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 22 tests covering each behavioral criterion, including a single-call assertion on the S3 predicate. Verification: test_args.py and test_regions.py pass (160 tests). Full tests/unit run: 3140 passed, 66 skipped, 11 failed; the same 11 failures (test_awsrequest.py x5, test_session.py x1, test_session_legacy.py x1) occur on the untouched tree, so they predate this change. No added lines exceed 79 columns. Nothing committed; the shared venv was not modified.
